title: Quiz: Grammar Basics
content:
Question 1

English: Choose the correct form: She _____ to school every day.

  • a) go
  • b) goes
  • c) going
  • d) went
Answer: b) goes

title: Quiz: Vocabulary
content:
Question 2

English: Which is a synonym of 'happy'?

  • a) sad
  • b) glad
  • c) angry
  • d) tired
Answer: b) glad

title: Quiz: Prepositions
content:
Question 3

English: Fill in the blank: She sat _____ the chair.

  • a) in
  • b) on
  • c) at
  • d) by
Answer: b) on

title: Quiz: Tenses
content:
Question 4

English: Choose the correct tense: They _____ to the gym yesterday.

  • a) go
  • b) went
  • c) goes
  • d) going
Answer: b) went

title: Quiz: Pronunciation
content:
Question 5

English: Choose the pair with the same stress pattern.

  • a) record (verb) / record (noun)
  • b) record (noun) / record (noun)
  • c) object (verb) / object (noun)
  • d) all of the above
Answer: d) all of the above
